title: Smiling Older Couple at Train Depot, 1940s WW2 Era Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Mom & Dad Wilson
taken at depot in Ontario the day Francis left for Officer's Training at Ft. Sill, Okla.

5-65
description: A black and white snapshot featuring an older couple ('Mom & Dad Wilson') posing outside a train station depot. The woman is smiling in a textured tailored jacket, while the man wears eyeglasses, a casual collared shirt, and a light jacket with hands tucked casually into his pockets. The photo is enclosed in a stylized geometric 'ELKO' print border. The handwritten note on the reverse explains this was taken the day their son, Francis, departed for military Officer's Training at Fort Sill, Oklahoma during World War II.
